event.distribution_pattern: Product was distributed to the states of Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York, Florida. There were no US governernment consignees or foreign consignees.

products.product_description: Humphrey Candy Kisses, 4 oz. individually wrapped and contained in a clear plastic bag, UPC Code 81084 00002. Bags are packed 40 to a case.
products.reason_for_recall: On 6/5/2012 the firm voluntarily recalled their Candy Kisses due to undeclared milk on the label.

products.product_description: Humphrey Chocolate Drizzle, 5 oz. in a clear plastic bag, UPC Code 8108400009. Bags are packed 12 to a case.
products.reason_for_recall: On 6/5/2012 the firm voluntarily recalled their Chocolate Drizzle Popcorn due to undeclared soy lecithin on the label.
